### Headline summary
- OpenAI secured an $11 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation, while Anthropic moves forward with its planned IPO. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/openai-secures-11b-in-initial-funding-at-1-25t-valuation/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/openai-lands-an-11-billion-funding-round-but-has-to-court-dentists-for-more-capital/), [Latent Space](https://latent.space/p/ainews-anthropic-ipo-whither-now/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropics-planned-ipo-puts-public-trust-and-data-centers-in-focus/))
- Political analysts suggest recent midterm election results may slow AI investment and alter the regulatory landscape for data centers. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-07/ai-safety-advocates-make-gains-after-110-million-midterm-fight), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/future-society/democratic-majority-ai-legislation-regulation-elections))
- An unreleased Anthropic model helped solve a major open question in quantum computing, and OpenAI's disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis has drawn attention for its implications on encryption. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/anthropic-quantum-computing-breakthrough-aaronson-ambainis-math-physics-psi-2026-11), [DEV Community](https://dev.to/vpodk/quantum-computing-speedup-limits-defined-by-new-proof-ach), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261107/p12#a261107p12), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/06/science/ai-exponential-time-hypothesis.html))

### OpenAI $11B Funding Round
OpenAI has secured an $11 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation, with reports noting the company is actively courting new capital sources such as dentists. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/openai-secures-11b-in-initial-funding-at-1-25t-valuation/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/openai-lands-an-11-billion-funding-round-but-has-to-court-dentists-for-more-capital/))

### Midterm Election Impact on AI and Data Centers
Political analysts and reports discuss how recent midterm election results and Democratic wins may slow AI investment, impact data center projects, and alter the regulatory landscape for the industry. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-07/ai-safety-advocates-make-gains-after-110-million-midterm-fight), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/future-society/democratic-majority-ai-legislation-regulation-elections), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/openai-voters-more-data-centers), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/will-democrats-crush-data-centers))

### Anthropic IPO Plans
Anthropic is moving forward with its planned IPO, a development that has drawn attention to public trust issues and the company's data center infrastructure despite a broader tech selloff. ([Latent Space](https://latent.space/p/ainews-anthropic-ipo-whither-now/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropics-planned-ipo-puts-public-trust-and-data-centers-in-focus/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropic-pushes-ahead-with-pre-thanksgiving-ipo-despite-tech-selloff-accepts-lower-valuation/))

### AI model used to solve quantum computing conjecture
Physical Superintelligence Inc. announced that an unreleased Anthropic model helped solve a major open question in quantum computing, resolving a conjecture that had been open since 2008. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/anthropic-quantum-computing-breakthrough-aaronson-ambainis-math-physics-psi-2026-11), [DEV Community](https://dev.to/vpodk/quantum-computing-speedup-limits-defined-by-new-proof-ach))

### OpenAI's disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis
Russell Impagliazzo, co-proposer of the Exponential Time Hypothesis, described OpenAI's disproof of the hypothesis as shocking news with potential implications for chip design and encryption. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261107/p12#a261107p12), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/06/science/ai-exponential-time-hypothesis.html))

### Investigation into Chinese firms handling Nvidia H200 chips
An investigation revealed that some Chinese firms approved by the US Commerce Department to handle Nvidia's H200 chips have empty offices and ties to sanctioned entities. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261107/p9#a261107p9), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1029483/nvidia-ai-chips-china-blacklist-government))

### Musk Texas Data Center Plans
SpaceX and Elon Musk are pursuing data center construction plans in Texas, facing potential regulatory hurdles from the Blue Wave but continuing to advance their ambitions. ([Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/future-society/texas-governor-elon-musk), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/blue-wave-may-stop-musks-texas-data-center-ambitions), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261107/p14#a261107p14))

### NVIDIA Cargo Van Theft
Reports detail the theft of $11.4 million worth of NVIDIA cargo from a food truck in the Bay Area, highlighting a trend of bold data center and hardware heists. ([DEV Community](https://dev.to/joho_todai/114-million-in-nvidia-cargo-vanishes-aboard-a-food-truck-ai-chip-theft-continues-in-the-bay-area-44c5), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114482-thieves-steal-114-million-nvidia-equipment-ai-hardware.html))
